title: C5G7 computational benchmark + KRITZ-2 experimental benchmark

use_for: verify C5G7 model identity and standard seven-group structure
evaluate six UO2/MOX placement layouts only after model gates pass
check candidate ranking and uncertainty handling within the C5G7 design space
C5G7.current_evidence: corrected-group 18-run smoke study exists; canonical high-budget confirmation and independent specification review remain required
C5G7.known_blocker: no defensible mapping from legacy fresh/once_burned/twice_burned QUBO labels to C5G7 UO2/MOX compositions

KRITZ2.preferred_case: KRITZ-2:19 MOX, cold and hot; use UO2 cases as additional cross-check if feasible
KRITZ2.required_model: finite experimental core model consistent with the OECD/NEA benchmark specification, including actual rod array, water height/leakage, boron, temperatures, densities, and material compositions
KRITZ2.invalid_shortcut: do not compare an infinite-lattice pin-cell k-infinity result directly with the experimental finite-core k-effective / participant-mean values
KRITZ2.current_status: reference data identified; full-core model not yet independently verified or executed in this repository

gates.name: C5G7 model identity
gates.pass_condition: standard energy group boundaries, source materials/geometry, and tally definitions independently reviewed

gates.name: C5G7 canonical convergence
gates.pass_condition: three independent high-budget seeds run on corrected model; raw statepoints audited; benchmark comparison reproducible

gates.name: KRITZ-2 full-core model
gates.pass_condition: finite-core geometry/materials/operating conditions reproduced from official specification and model audit passes

gates.name: KRITZ-2 experimental comparison
gates.pass_condition: OpenMC results from the matching full-core model compared against evaluated experimental values with uncertainty treatment and residuals reported

gates.name: Cross-benchmark interpretation
gates.pass_condition: report distinct C5G7 computational-verification and KRITZ experimental-validation conclusions; no transfer of KRITZ validation to unmatched C5G7 configurations

gates.name: QUBO/CB-PFR physical claim
gates.pass_condition: design mapping, objective, constraints, uncertainty propagation, and candidate scoring all have auditable evidence

explicit_nonclaims: C5G7 and KRITZ-2 are not one interchangeable geometry or dataset.
KRITZ-2 does not include interspersed UO2/MOX rod arrangements for validating the six 2x2 C5G7 layouts directly.
A pin-cell calculation is not a finite-core experimental validation.
A matching keff alone does not validate pin power or the QUBO-to-physics mapping.
No physical validation is declared passed until the matching model is executed and independently audited.
